# glyf

> An open-source visualisation build tool for data pipelines: .ggsql chart files and dashboard YAML beside a dbt project, rendered by a CLI into static dashboards.

glyf reads dbt artifacts (target/manifest.json) to resolve ref() and source(), executes chart SQL with DuckDB, renders charts with Altair, and writes static HTML dashboards. It never runs dbt and needs no server.

Install (PyPI distribution glyf-core, command glyf):

```bash
uv tool install glyf-core
glyf --version
```

Or, on macOS and Linux:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/glyf-data/glyf/main/install.sh | sh
```

- /dashboards/finance-metrics/dashboards/finance.html

Key project files:

- dbt_project.yml: dbt project definition.
- glyf.yml: glyf paths, execution, render, and dashboard config (optional; defaults apply).
- models/: dbt SQL models.
- target/manifest.json: dbt artifact used to resolve ref() and source().
- visualisations/*.ggsql: chart SQL followed by VISUALISE, DRAW, LABEL, CONFIG, and INTERACT directives.
- dashboards/*.yml: dashboard definitions; dashboards/macros.py: optional project-local macros.
- target/glyf/: compiled SQL, chart artifacts, dashboards, bundle.json, and the exported site/.

Scaffold:

```bash
glyf init          # from the dbt project root: glyf.yml, visualisations/, dashboards/, one starter chart and dashboard
glyf init --clean  # replace the starter chart and dashboard files, keep glyf.yml
```

Core workflow:

```bash
dbt build     # produce target/manifest.json and the relations
glyf doctor   # check artifacts, refs, and dependencies
glyf build    # validate + render + dashboard + export, in one step
glyf serve    # preview target/glyf/site locally
```

Step-by-step equivalents of build: glyf validate, glyf render, glyf dashboard, glyf export [--clean --zip]. Every command accepts --project-dir path/to/dbt_project and --config path/to/glyf.yml.

Chart syntax: SQL, then VISUALISE <col> AS x, <col> AS y[, <col> AS color]; DRAW line|bar|scatter|area|pie; LABEL title|subtitle|x_title|y_title => "..."; CONFIG width|height => <int>; INTERACT tooltip, zoom, legend_filter (legend_filter needs a color mapping).

Assistant workflow:

1. If visualisations/ or dashboards/ are missing, suggest glyf init.
2. Read dbt_project.yml, glyf.yml, models/, target/manifest.json, visualisations/, and dashboards/.
3. Create or update a .ggsql file under visualisations/ using an existing model name and ref().
4. Add the chart name (the filename stem) to a dashboard YAML under dashboards/.
5. Run glyf doctor and glyf build.
6. Report changed files, validation results, and anything that needs human review.

Guardrails:

- Do not edit dbt models unless asked.
- Use only the directives, chart types, and interactions listed above.
- Preserve existing dashboard YAML unless the change requires an update.
- Report unresolved refs, a missing target/manifest.json, missing chart files, and DuckDB execution errors directly.
